content: The Russian dataset is more homogeneous compared to the English one, as for all the target words there is approximately the same number of context words in the examples. This is achieved by applying the lexical window (25 words before and after the target word) and cropping everything that falls outside of that window. In the English dataset, on the contrary, the whole paragraph with the target word is taken into account. We have tried cropping the examples for English as well, but it did not result in any change in the quality of classification. In the end, we decided not to apply the lexical window to the English dataset so as not to alter it and rather use it in the original form.
